wow_compatibility.description: WoW client compatibility, localization, and addon distribution readiness
wow_compatibility.instructions: Review the active addon against WoW client contracts and current primary API sources. Focus on localized RANDOM_ROLL_RESULT parsing, cross-realm and UTF-8 player identity, deprecated or restricted chat APIs, UI lifecycle contracts with AceGUI, and dependency packaging/load order. Distinguish source-confirmed defects from client-dependent concerns. Do not promise future compatibility or infer support from TOC numbers alone. Report precise file references, severity, reproduction conditions and minimal corrections. Remain read-only and do not repeat preparation.
wow_compatibility.reason: The addon advertises multiple WoW client families, parses English-only rolls, uses direct client globals, and packages without embedded dependencies; a client-contract review is required beyond generic QA.
